respins.how_it_works:
Pink, Gold and Purple Piggy Banks are located outside of the grid. When Pink, Gold and Purple Lucky Hammer symbols land, they will charge the Piggy Banks with the corresponding color. When Piggy Banks are charged, there is a chance that it will activate at the end of the spin after all wins have been handled. Only one Piggy Bank can activate per spin. The animation does not influence the activation of the 3 Piggy Banks.

 When a Pink Piggy Bank is activated, a Magic Wild Respin is triggered, where any combination of regular paying symbols, Wild or Wild Multipliers will land. Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. When a Wild Multiplier symbol participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the shown value. If more than one Wild Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win. Wild Multipliers can have the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x.

 When a Gold Piggy Bank is activated, a Magic Coins Bonus sequence is triggered, with 3 refilling lives equaling 3 free spins. Lives are displayed outside of the grid. During the Magic Coins Bonus sequence, Dead symbols can land that are non-paying and have no other effect.

 Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond Coins can also land and stick to the grid until the end of the Magic Coins Bonus sequence. All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet

modes.name: BONUS GAME - SWINDLE AND SWINE
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 7-15 free spins by landing FS scatter symbols at the same time during the Magic FS Respin in base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, when the 3rd Lucky Hammer symbol of the same color lands, the corresponding Piggy Bank is guaranteed to activate. Piggy Banks can activate before the 3rd Lucky Hammer symbol lands; in this case, the count resets, and 3 new Lucky Hammer symbols of that color are required to guarantee an activation.

 When activated, the Magic Coins Bonus sequence counts as one free spin.

 The number of FS symbols that land during the Magic FS Respin determines the number of extra free spins awarded in this bonus. In this bonus, the additional free spins awarded during the Magic FS Respin are between 2 and 10. If an FS Upgrade symbol lands, it awards an upgrade into the EPIG HEIST bonus. When upgrading to a new bonus, the existing free spins and the awarded free spins will be transferred to the new bonus.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - EPIG HEIST
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 7-15 free spins by landing FS scatter symbols and 1 FS Upgrade symbol at the same time during the Magic FS Respin.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, when a Lucky Hammer symbol lands, it will activate the corresponding Piggy Bank on that spin.

 When activated, the Magic Coins Bonus sequence counts as one free spin.

 The number of FS symbols that land during the Magic FS Respin determines the number of extra free spins awarded in this bonus. In this bonus, the additional free spins awarded during the Magic FS Respin are between 2 and 10.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Only one Lucky Hammer symbol of each color can land at the same time during a spin.

 Wild and Wild Multiplier symbols can only land in the Magic Wild Respin.

 Coins can only land in Magic Coins Bonus sequence.

 Dead symbols can only land in the Magic Coins Bonus sequence and the Magic FS Respin.

 FS symbols can only land in the Magic FS Respin.

 FS Upgrade symbols cannot land in the EPIG HEIST bonus
